title: "Live vs pre-recorded AI demo agents: how to tell them apart"
summary: "Some AI demo agents drive the real product live, others play captured tours or videos. Six tools checked, plus a 2-minute test to tell them apart."
body_markdown:
A live AI demo agent drives the real product in a browser while it talks, so it can show any screen the buyer asks for. A pre-recorded AI demo agent holds the conversation on top of something captured earlier (an interactive tour, a video, a document or a clone of the product), so it can only show what someone recorded before the call.


Karumi is an AI demo agent: an autonomous agent that shows a buyer your real product live, by voice or chat, and answers questions as it goes. In this post we explain the two kinds, go through Navattic, Storylane RepX, Supademo, Walnut, Consensus and Karumi with sources, and give you a test that tells them apart in 2 minutes. All vendor facts were checked November 2026.


## What is the difference between a live and a pre-recorded AI demo agent?


The difference is not the voice, the avatar or the chat window. It is what sits behind the agent when the buyer asks "can you show me that?".


Live AI demo agent Pre-recorded AI demo agent


What the buyer sees The real product, in a browser the agent controls Captured screens, a video, a doc or a clone


Off-path questions It can go to any screen the demo account can reach It can only open what someone captured


After a product release It shows the new screens at once It shows old screens until someone re-captures them


Typing and clicking Real input, real reactions from the product Fixed values that were captured earlier


Main setup work A demo account with safe data Building and keeping the tours or videos


Both kinds are useful. If you want the longer argument about why a two-way conversation beats a one-way asset, read our post on[one-way vs two-way product demos](https://karumi.ai/blog/one-way-vs-two-way-product-demos) .


## How do the main AI demo agents work in 2026?


We read each vendor's own product page, quote it, and say what each one does well.


### Navattic Agents


Navattic says its agents "guide and qualify prospects, answer questions, demo key workflows, and show content in real time". The product it shows is a copy: Navattic's page says the agent can "show a realistic clone of your product instead of just static screenshots or videos" ([Navattic Agents](https://www.navattic.com/product/agent-demos) , checked November 2026). The buyer talks through a chat widget or an optional AI avatar.


Supademo's comparison page adds that Navattic agents also support live demo accounts as well as Navattic sandbox builds ([Supademo](https://supademo.com/blog/navattic-vs-storylane-vs-supademo) , checked November 2026). Navattic's own page leads with the clone.


**Good at:** teams that already build Navattic demos get an agent on top of content they trust, with intent signals and session insights.


### Storylane RepX


Storylane says RepX "proactively pulls up relevant interactive demos based on what the buyer cares about" and that it "talks over text, voice, and video" ([Storylane RepX](https://www.storylane.io/repx) , checked November 2026). The page also says it walks through the real product. In practice, what RepX opens are the interactive demos you built in Storylane, so the screens are the ones you captured.


**Good at:** website inbound. RepX greets visitors, qualifies against your ICP and books meetings, and it can choose between your existing demos for each buyer.


### Supademo AI Demo Agent


Supademo is the most direct about its design: "The agent answers in text or voice, then opens the interactive demo, video, or doc that shows the answer" ([Supademo AI Demo Agent](https://supademo.com/ai/demo-agents) , checked November 2026). It runs discovery on role, use case and urgency, supports voice and text in 50+ languages, and is a usage-based add-on on paid plans (Scale and up) as of November 2026.


**Good at:** fast setup with published pricing, and a mix of formats (demos, decks, case studies) in one conversation.


### Walnut Buyer Xpert


Walnut calls Buyer Xpert "the AI buyer agent that lives inside your demo". It is embedded in a Walnut interactive demo, knows the screen and the guide step the buyer is on, and answers only from content you approved. Buyers can type or talk to it. Walnut says "Buyer Xpert runs in interactive demos today", and that it is "included in every Walnut plan" ([Walnut Buyer Xpert](https://www.walnut.io/personalized-interactive-demos/ai-buyer-xpert/) , checked November 2026). Walnut demos are built from captures of your web, desktop and mobile apps, recordings and videos ([Walnut](https://www.walnut.io/) , checked November 2026).


Walnut also has Walnut Live, which shows "your real product, on the call", but that one is rep-led, not agent-led.


**Good at:** strict answer control. It says when it does not know and brings in a human instead of guessing.


### Consensus


Consensus is best known for video demos ([Naoma's Consensus vs Walnut](https://naoma.ai/articles/consensus-vs-walnut) , checked November 2026). Its AI Demo Agent "delivers fully autonomous, product demos that let buyers click and explore for themselves" ([Consensus AI Agents](https://goconsensus.com/ai-agents) , checked November 2026). The buyer explores product experiences that the presales team prepared, not a live session in your app.


**Good at:** enterprise deals with buying committees, where many stakeholders need the same demo and the team needs to know who watched what.


### Karumi


Karumi's agent takes control of a real browser that is already signed in to your product and clicks through it the way a person would, while it talks to the buyer ([Is Karumi live or a recording?](https://karumi.ai/blog/is-karumi-demo-live-or-recording) ). The buyer can interrupt at any point and ask for any screen. You choose which parts of the product the agent may show.


It talks by voice or chat, in the buyer's language, and it can join Google Meet, Zoom and Teams calls ([Can Karumi join calls?](https://karumi.ai/blog/can-karumi-join-google-meet-zoom-teams-calls) ). It qualifies and scores the lead, books the meeting on the right rep's calendar, and writes the session to HubSpot or Salesforce.


One honest note: some teams prefer stable demo data, so Karumi can also run on an offline replica with fake data. The agent still drives that replica live in a browser. It is not a recording and not a tour.


**Good at:** buyers who ask questions off the main path, and products that ship often.

## What is each kind good at?


**Pre-recorded agents are good when:**


- You already have a library of interactive demos and want a conversation on top of them.
- Your product is hard to show live (long load times, heavy setup, sensitive data).
- You want every buyer to see the exact same polished path.


**Live agents are good when:**


- Buyers ask questions you did not plan for, such as a niche setting or an integration screen.
- You ship often and do not want to re-capture tours after each release.
- The buyer needs to see the product react: type a value, filter a list, open a record.
- You want the agent on a sales call, not only on the website.


In our experience, buyers ask about pricing, integrations and their own use case early. A captured tour rarely has a screen ready for "how would this work for my team?". A live agent can go and look.


## How can a buyer tell them apart in 2 minutes?


Open the demo and run these five checks. Each takes about 20 seconds.


1. **Ask for a screen off the main path.** For example: "Show me where I set user permissions." A live agent goes there. A pre-recorded agent says it cannot, or opens the closest tour or video.
2. **Ask it to type your own words.** For example: "Create a record called Test from my company." A live agent types it and the product reacts. A captured demo shows fixed values.
3. **Interrupt in the middle of a step.** Change the topic halfway. A live agent stops and goes where you asked. A video keeps playing or restarts.
4. **Look for tour marks.** Next buttons, step counters, pulsing hotspots, tooltips and a video scrub bar all mean captured content.
5. **Ask the same question twice, in other words.** A pre-recorded agent often opens the same clip both times. A live agent can take a different path.


If an agent passes three or more checks, it is very likely driving a real product. If it fails most, it is a conversation on top of captured content. Neither is bad; you just know what you are buying.


## Does it matter which kind you choose?


It matters most in three places:


- **Upkeep.** Captured tours go stale when the product changes. Someone has to re-capture them. A live agent shows the current product, but you need a demo account with data any buyer may see.
- **Depth of questions.** If your buyers are technical and ask detailed questions, a pre-recorded agent will hit the edge of its content fast.
- **Where the demo happens.** Most pre-recorded agents live on the website. Karumi can also join a video call, so one agent covers inbound, outbound links and scheduled calls.

## FAQ


### Is a pre-recorded AI demo agent the same as an interactive demo?


No. An interactive demo is the captured tour itself. A pre-recorded AI demo agent adds a conversation on top: it answers questions and opens the right tour, video or doc. The screens are still the ones someone captured.


### Can a live AI demo agent break during a demo?


A live agent works in a real product, so pop-ups or slow pages can get in the way. Good agents recover and continue. Karumi also offers an offline replica with fake data for teams that want a fixed environment, and the agent still drives it live.


### Which AI demo agents drive the real product live?


Karumi drives your real product in a live browser. Navattic, Storylane RepX, Supademo, Walnut Buyer Xpert and Consensus show captured demos, videos, docs or a clone, based on their own pages checked in November 2026.


### Is a live AI demo agent safe for my product data?


Use a demo account with data any buyer may see. You also choose which parts of the product the agent may show. Karumi's Enterprise plan includes SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001 and GDPR, as listed on its[pricing page](https://karumi.ai/pricing) .


### Do I need to choose one kind only?


No. Many teams keep tours on product pages and a live agent on the main demo button: tours for browsing, a live agent for buyers with real questions.
